title: hbench dataset source descriptor, version 1
description: Where a dataset version's task directories come from, and what the published dataset declares. Stored at datasets/<name>/<version>/source.yaml.

name.description: Dataset name: the OCI repository under ghcr.io/node-q/hbench-datasets/ and the <name> in hbench's -d <name>@<version>. Must match the descriptor's directory.

version.description: Dataset version: the OCI tag. Must match the descriptor's directory. A published version is immutable; a change of bytes is a new version.

description.description: What the dataset measures and what a task contains.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the task directories as published. LICENSE in the descriptor's directory holds its text.

keywords.description: Discovery keywords, copied into the Croissant metadata.

upstream.description: The dataset this version is derived from.

revision.description: Upstream revision this version is derived from: a commit, tag or dataset revision.

creator.description: Who created the upstream dataset, as they name themselves.

citation.description: How the upstream authors ask to be cited, preferably BibTeX.

canary.description: The upstream's canary string, kept in every published task and repeated in the metadata, so training corpora can filter the dataset out.

source.description: Where CI gets the task directories: a git repository at a pinned commit, or, with kind generated, an adapter in this repository run over pinned upstream files. No task files are committed to this repository.

environment.description: How the tasks' prebuilt environment images are referenced.

policy.description: as-declared: task.toml is published byte-identical, images exactly as upstream declares them. pinned-by-digest: every task's docker_image is pinned to the digest in images. built: for a generated source, every task's docker_image is the built image named by image, pinned by digest from images.lock.json next to the descriptor, and its environment/ is that image's build context.

declared_image.description: The docker_image every task declares, with {task} standing for the task directory's name. CI checks each task.toml against it.

images.description: Task name to image reference pinned by digest.

planned.description: A change of environment policy planned for a later version.

image.description: For the built policy: the image's tag in images/images.yaml, <dataset>-<version>, a tag of ghcr.io/node-q/hbench-envs.

attribution.description: Attribution notes: authorship, the licence's origin, and what this repository changed, if anything.

rai.description: Croissant RAI fields that apply to the dataset.

git_source.description: A git repository holding the task directories, at a pinned commit.

git_url.description: Git repository holding the task directories.

commit.description: Full commit SHA the task directories are packed from.

path.description: Directory within the repository whose subdirectories are the tasks; '.' for the repository root.

task_count.description: Number of task directories at that path and commit. CI refuses to pack any other number.

generated_source.description: Task directories this repository generates: the adapter's generate() writes them from the upstream files, each checked against its sha256. generated.lock.json next to the descriptor holds each task's package digest, and CI refuses tasks that differ from it.

adapter.description: The adapter's directory in this repository, adapters/<name>, holding adapter.py.

upstream_files.description: The files the adapter reads, each at a fixed URL, such as a release asset or a dataset file at a pinned revision.

task_count.description: Number of task directories the adapter writes. CI refuses to pack any other number.

name.description: The file name the adapter reads it by.

sha256.description: Its sha256, in lowercase hex. A download with any other digest is refused.
